title: pretty KIMORA|Plus Size Printed Chiffon Pleated Maxi Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Soft and romantic, this?floor length wedding guest dress?is made to flatter beautifully. The gathered neckline and short sleeves frame the shoulders and upper body with a gentle, feminine feel, while the defined waist helps shape the figure. The flowing skirt moves gracefully and gives the whole look an elegant finish for weddings and special occasions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
